tests.prompt: Every time I try to add a second item to my cart, the page just freezes and I have to refresh.
tests.expected: Asks for the missing environment detail (browser or device). Does not file a ticket yet.

tests.prompt: Using the Android app on my Pixel 8, the search bar returns zero results no matter what I type, even for products I know exist. I've tried searching 'shoes' and 'bag' and both come back empty.
tests.expected: All three fields present in one message. Files the ticket immediately and returns the ticket ID.

tests.prompt: How long does delivery usually take?
tests.expected: Answers using the FAQ's stated processing time of 1-2 business days before dispatch.

tests.prompt: Can I pay in installments with Klarna?
tests.expected: Acknowledges this isn't covered in the FAQ and hands off instead of guessing an answer.

tests.prompt: This chatbot isn't helping, can you connect me with an actual support agent?
tests.expected: Gives a polite handoff to a human agent. No tool call is triggered.

tests.prompt: It's day 12 and tracking still says 'preparing for shipment' - what's going on?
tests.expected: Classified as FAQ (delivery delay), not a bug report, per the routing rule.

tests.prompt: My debit card was rejected twice at checkout even though I have enough funds.
tests.expected: Classified as FAQ (payment issue), not a bug report, per the routing rule.
